visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, wearing a black GAP sweatshirt and a dark bead bracelet, stands in an underground parking garage with concrete pillars labeled A-2 and A-3. He holds a denim jacket in one hand and gestures enthusiastically with the other while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to a bright retail store environment with shelves displaying numerous Pop Mart collectible toy boxes. The man holds a large 'Mega Space Molly x Stitch' box, rotating it to show the artwork. He smiles broadly, expressing excitement through his facial movements. (3) In an indoor setting filled with stacks of cardboard boxes, a woman in a beige outfit holds the large toy box. Two young children stand nearby, watching the reveal with interest. The camera moves in a handheld fashion to capture their reactions.
